text:
zoe: PioneerAnalytics (acct 9784) reached out  their June invoice is missing the GPU reserved compute line and they received two PDFs with the same base invoice id. one PDF totals $9,600, the other $0.00 for compute. attached screenshots.
ricky: can we get invoice ids and the invoice-run id? @eng-billing-bot pull run 2026-06-10-9784 and dispatched files.
eng-billing-bot: invoice-run id=2026-06-10-9784 started 2026-06-10T03:20Z finished with warnings. Warnings: [usage_merge:inconsistent_key] for sku tokens: reserved-gpu-8x vs reserved_gpu_8x. Generated PDFs: INV-2026-0610_v1.pdf (compute line present), INV-2026-0610_v2.pdf (compute line omitted).
anika: that smells like the recent sku canonicalization change. We normalized dashes to underscores which changed how grouping dedupe matched. If two runs used different canonicalizers, one merge may have dropped the reserved line as duplicate.
zoe: customer says they were charged the full amount on their card but portal shows the invoice without compute. they want a corrected invoice in the portal and a signed correction email.
ricky: immediate steps: 1) put acct 9784 in billing-hold to prevent further re-issues; 2) check payment capture and which PDF was attached to the capture; 3) regen canonical invoice using the stable canonicalizer and publish one authoritative invoice matching the charge.
eng-billing-bot: payment capture trace: capture id=pay_z9x8 amount_cents=960000 attached to INV-2026-0610_v1.pdf. Database invoice record currently shows INV-2026-0610_v2 (missing compute) due to later publish.
anika: ok, so payment matches v1. we must not overwrite published records after capture. I'll run a targeted regen using legacy canonicalization (dash-preserving) in dry-run and post CSV.
eng-billing-bot: dry-run regen 2026-06-10-9784-rr completed. Result: canonical invoice includes compute line: 720 hours @ $200/hr = $144,000 cents ($1,440.00) wait numbers: actually line shows 48 hours @ $200 = $9,600; total matches capture (960000 cents). publish=false.
zoe: finance: can you create a provisional credit memo to cover any accidental duplicate charge until we confirm? we need ability to issue credit quickly if needed.
finance-bot: created provisional credit-memo CM-2026-1102 for acct 9784, amount_cents=960000, status: pending-approval. Approver: ricky.
ricky: approved but mark as placeholder contingent on regen outcome. add analyst note: "possible duplicate invoice due to sku canonicalization change; awaiting regen."
anika: I'll prepare a hotfix to use the stable sku canonicalizer for invoice re-runs and add a migration step so canonicalization changes run a non-destructive dry-run across a sample before going live. Also adding unit test to ensure merge-key is stable across variants.
zoe: customer requested ETA; they want this fixed today. can we expedite?
ricky: priority high. anika, after dry-run signoff, go ahead and publish corrected invoice as INV-2026-0610-CORR and void the v2 portal record. finance then apply CM-2026-1102 as needed.
anika: publishing now after safety checks. publish complete. Inv changes: INV-2026-0610_v2 voided, INV-2026-0610-CORR issued; portal updated to show CORR matching capture.
finance-bot: applied CM-2026-1102 placeholder and then cleared it after confirming no duplicate charge processed. status: CM-2026-1102 cleared.
legal: please include a short two-line explanation in the correction email for audit: "An internal normalization change to SKU tokens produced two renderings of your invoice; we have voided the incorrect copy and issued a corrected invoice that matches the amount charged." Add signed PDF and audit id.
zoe: emailed PioneerAnalytics with signed correction and confirmation that portal now matches their bank charge. customer replied: "Thanks, invoice now matches and portal shows credit voided invoice. appreciated the quick turnaround."
anika: root cause ticket filed: SKU canonicalization change altered merge-key semantics. mitigation: freeze canonicalization changes during billing windows, add non-destructive rollout plan and regression tests for merge-key stability.
ricky: follow-up: we'll schedule a billing postmortem and notify product and eng-platform teams. marking this thread closed once postmortem is scheduled. :white_check_mark:
